macros.name: aboveanswersSkip
macros.doc: The space above the beginning of the answer environment can be adjusted using the length \aboveanswersSkip.

macros.name: AddAAKeystroke
macros.doc: The exerquiz key \AddAAKeystroke adds its argument (⟨code⟩) to the keystroke event of all response boxes (\RespBoxMath, \RespBoxTxt, and \RespBoxTxtPC).

macros.name: AddAAMouseUpMC
macros.doc: \AddAAMouseUpMC{⟨code⟩} This key adds its ⟨code⟩ to the mouse up event of items (\Ans) of a multiple choice (MC) question.

macros.name: AddAAMouseUpMS
macros.doc: \AddAAMouseUpMS{⟨code⟩} This key adds its ⟨code⟩ to the mouse up event of items (\Ans) of a multiple selection (MS) question.

macros.name: allowRandomizedChoices
macros.doc: \allowRandomizedChoices restores the authority of the allowrandomize option.

macros.name: CorrAnsButton
macros.doc: The correct solution can be included in the question as well; just include the command \CorrAnsButton. This command takes one parameter, the correct answer that will be viewed when the user clicks on the button.

macros.name: CorrAnsButton
macros.doc: The correct solution can be included in the question as well; just include the command \CorrAnsButton. This command takes one parameter, the correct answer that will be viewed when the user clicks on the button.

macros.name: CorrAnsButtonGrp
macros.doc: When you use the mathGrp environment to enclose a set of related math questions, you need to use the \CorrAnsButtonGrp button, instead of the \CorrAnsButton button. The required argument for this button is a comma delimited list of the answers that appear within the grouped questions.

macros.name: CorrAnsButtonGrp
macros.doc: When you use the mathGrp environment to enclose a set of related math questions, you need to use the \CorrAnsButtonGrp button, instead of the \CorrAnsButton button. The required argument for this button is a comma delimited list of the answers that appear within the grouped questions.

macros.name: DeclareQuiz
macros.doc: The \DeclareQuiz command takes one argument, which is the name of the quiz, for example \DeclareQuiz{myQuiz}. This command takes it argument and creates a text macro \currQuiz, which expands to the quiz name.

macros.name: defaultquiztype
macros.doc: You can make the environments revert back to their normal behavior by using the command \defaultquiztype, which cancels out the \quiztype command.

macros.name: displaySumryTbl
macros.doc: The \displaySumryTbl command creates a table that summarizes the user’s effort for the quiz; \displaySumryTbl must follow the final \end{questions} and must be on a separate page from the last question of the quiz.

macros.name: displaySumryTbl
macros.doc: The \displaySumryTbl command creates a table that summarizes the user’s effort for the quiz; \displaySumryTbl must follow the final \end{questions} and must be on a separate page from the last question of the quiz.

macros.name: doNotRandomizeChoices
macros.doc: The command \doNotRandomizeChoices overrides the allowrandomize option; when in effect, randomization of the choices does not occur.

macros.name: eAns
macros.doc: The end of the choice is delimited by the \eAns command (which is undefined, but is used as a argument delimiter).

macros.name: eFreeze
macros.doc: Any of the items listed after \eFreeze are not randomized, and are placed at the end of the list.

macros.name: everyqRadioButton
macros.doc: The appearance of these radio buttons can be modified using the command \everyqRadioButton.

macros.name: everysqRadioButton
macros.doc: The radio buttons can be modified using the command \everysqRadioButton.

macros.name: exbookmarkfmt
macros.doc: Every bookmark title, ⟨bookmark_title⟩, has a suffix defined with \exbookmarkfmt or \partbookmarkfmt, depending on whether the entry is for the top-level exercise, or one of its parts.

macros.name: exlabel
macros.doc: This command expands to the name of the exercise label, the default string is ‘Exercise’.

macros.name: exlabelformat
macros.doc: Typesets the exercise label; use it to introduce additional type style such as boldface, italic, small caps, etc.

macros.name: exlabelsol
macros.doc: Expands to the name of the exercise label in the solutions section.

macros.name: exrtnlabelformat
macros.doc: This is the label you click on to return from the solution of the exercise.

macros.name: exsecrunhead
macros.doc: The running header for the solution section for the exercises.

macros.name: exsectitle
macros.doc: The section title of the solutions to the exercises.

macros.name: exsllabelformat
macros.doc: The format of the solutions label, \bfseries\exlabel is the default.

macros.name: fancyQuizHeaders
macros.doc: The \fancyQuizHeaders command, a companion feature to \titleQuiz, enhances the labeling of the quiz in the solutions section of the document.

macros.name: floatQuiz
macros.doc: The command \floatQuiz declares the current quiz, as set by the \DeclareQuiz command, is floating, which means the ‘Begin Quiz’ and ‘End Quiz’ link-text or buttons are separated from their usual placement and are allowed to “float.”

macros.name: formatAsSet
macros.doc: The command \formatAsSet expands to a JavaScript function that is defined when the setSupport option is taken.

macros.name: graylettersOn
macros.doc: The gray letter feature can be turned on and off locally: To turn on this feature, insert the command \graylettersOn at some appropriately chosen point in the document; to turn off the gray letter feature insert \graylettersOff.

macros.name: hideCreditMarkup
macros.doc: The command \hideCreditMarkup hides this markup (it switches off the previous \showCreditMarkup); place this command before a quiz for which you don’t want the markup.

macros.name: inputRandomSeed
macros.doc: The command \saveRandomSeed will write the last seed used in the source file to an auxiliary file (\jobname_rt.sav), while the command \inputRandomSeed inputs the seed stored in the \jobname_rt.sav back into the beginning of the source file.

macros.name: makeExSolnsLocalOff
macros.doc: You can now declare \makeExSolnsLocalOn or \makeExSolnsLocalOff anywhere in the document to turn on grouping for all exercises that follow, or to turn off this feature again.

macros.name: makeQzSolnsLocalOn
macros.doc: You can now declare \makeQzSolnsLocalOn or \makeQzSolnsLocalOff anywhere in the document to turn on grouping for all quizzes that follow, or to turn off this feature again.

macros.name: minQuizResp
macros.doc: The document author can write a custom threshold function and place its name in the \minQuizResp macro.

macros.name: negPointsAllowed
macros.doc: If you want exerquiz to report the true point score, use the command \negPointsAllowed in the preamble. This will allow the reporting of a negative point total.

macros.name: NoPeeking
macros.doc: If you execute the command \NoPeeking in the preamble of your document, or prior to a quiz, then any quiz question with solution will be protected somewhat from prying eyes.

macros.name: noResetAnsFieldOnClose
macros.doc: You can revert back to the default behavior (answer fields not cleared) by executing \noResetAnsFieldOnClose.

macros.name: oqpriorhook
macros.doc: The oQuestion environment has one hook \oqpriorhook that is expanded just prior to the opening of the environment.

macros.name: partbookmarkfmt
macros.doc: Every bookmark title, ⟨bookmark_title⟩, has a suffix defined with \exbookmarkfmt or \partbookmarkfmt, depending on whether the entry is for the top-level exercise, or one of its parts.

macros.name: popquestions
macros.doc: Between items, you can say \pushquestions, make a comment, to continue with more questions, type \popquestions.

macros.name: PTs
macros.doc: This macro takes one argument, the number of points to be assigned to the current problem.

macros.name: PTs*
macros.doc: This macro takes one argument, the number of points to be assigned to the current problem.

macros.name: PTsHook
macros.doc: This macro, which takes one argument, can be used to typeset the points assigned. and is called by \PTs.

macros.name: pushquestions
macros.doc: Between items, you can say \pushquestions, make a comment, to continue with more questions, type \popquestions.

macros.name: quesNumColor
macros.doc: The color of the item labels is set by the command \quesNumColor. The command take one argument, a named color.

macros.name: quizpdfbookmark
macros.doc: To bookmark a shortquiz or quiz, use \quizpdfbookmark.

macros.name: quiztype
macros.doc: Placing \quiztype{f} in the preamble (or prior to any quiz) will cause all quizzes following that command to be form-type quizzes.

macros.name: REF
macros.doc: \REF acts like the LaTeX command \ref with the hyperref modifications, but it converts the reference to uppercase.

macros.name: REF*
macros.doc: \REF acts like the LaTeX command \ref with the hyperref modifications, but it converts the reference to uppercase.

macros.name: renameSolnAfterTo
macros.doc: The command \renameSolnAfterTo can be used for conveniently changing the solution after label, for example, \renameSolnAfterTo{\textbf{Proof:}} changes the label to Proof:, and \renameSolnAfterTo{} produces no label.

macros.name: resetAnsFieldOnClose
macros.doc: By using the command \resetAnsFieldOnClose, the answer field for the current quiz will be cleared when the page containing it closes.

macros.name: resetMClabelsep
macros.doc: \resetMClabelsep resets the space back to its default ‘\ ’.

macros.name: resetSolnAfterToDefault
macros.doc: The command \resetSolnAfterToDefault sets the label text back to the default.

macros.name: RespBoxMath
macros.doc: The traditional way of posing a mathematical objective-style question is to use the \RespBoxMath command, which presents an empty text field for the student to enter the answer.

macros.name: RespBoxMath
macros.doc: The traditional way of posing a mathematical objective-style question is to use the \RespBoxMath command, which presents an empty text field for the student to enter the answer.

macros.name: RespBoxTxt
macros.doc: You can also pose a question that takes a simple text response. The basic command for posing this type of question is \RespBoxTxt.

macros.name: RespBoxTxt
macros.doc: You can also pose a question that takes a simple text response. The basic command for posing this type of question is \RespBoxTxt.

macros.name: RespBoxTxtPC
macros.doc: The command \RespBoxTxtPC is the one that creates a text fill-in question.

macros.name: RespBoxTxtPC
macros.doc: The command \RespBoxTxtPC is the one that creates a text fill-in question.

macros.name: rfootContStr
macros.doc: The message that appears in the right footer is \rfootContStr; the command takes two argument, the second of which is a short string that identifies the question.

macros.name: rowsep
macros.doc: Space between rows (or items in list environment) can be adjusted with the \rowsep command.

macros.name: saveRandomSeed
macros.doc: The command \saveRandomSeed will write the last seed used in the source file to an auxiliary file (\jobname_rt.sav), while the command \inputRandomSeed inputs the seed stored in the \jobname_rt.sav back into the beginning of the source file.

macros.name: ScoreField
macros.doc: The expansion of \ScoreField produces a read-only text field that is 1.5 inches in width with a red border.

macros.name: ScoreField
macros.doc: The expansion of \ScoreField produces a read-only text field that is 1.5 inches in width with a red border.

macros.name: setActionKeys
macros.doc: The command \setActionKeys is a special command used to process the KV-pairs of the eforms package.

macros.name: setsolnspace
macros.doc: This is a hook into the space immediately following the header.

macros.name: showCreditMarkup
macros.doc: Place the command \showCreditMarkup before a quiz you want the partial credit markup.

macros.name: sqClearButton
macros.doc: Finally, the \sqClearButton command creates a pushbutton whose action is to clear the short-quiz, including the tally boxes.

macros.name: sqClearButton
macros.doc: Finally, the \sqClearButton command creates a pushbutton whose action is to clear the short-quiz, including the tally boxes.

macros.name: sqSolnMCMsg
macros.doc: If the respondent presses the Ans button before selecting the correct answer, an alert box appears with message determined by \sqSolnMCMsg.

macros.name: sqSolnMSMsg
macros.doc: If the user presses the Ans button before selecting all correct answers, an alert box appears with message determined by \sqSolnMSMsg.

macros.name: sqTallyBox
macros.doc: The macro \sqTallyBox is used to keep a running total of the number of wrong answers a user has entered into the response box.

macros.name: sqTallyBox
macros.doc: The macro \sqTallyBox is used to keep a running total of the number of wrong answers a user has entered into the response box.

macros.name: startQuizHere
macros.doc: \startQuizHere inserts the ‘Begin Quiz’ link text or form button, while the \endQuizHere command inserts the ‘End Quiz’ link or form button.

macros.name: sumrytablesep
macros.doc: Sets the separation between the tables, in the case that two tables are generated.

macros.name: titleQuiz
macros.doc: To assign a title to your short quiz use \titleQuiz.

macros.name: titleQuiz
macros.doc: To assign a title to your short quiz use \titleQuiz.

macros.name: titleQuiz*
macros.doc: To assign a title to your short quiz use \titleQuiz.

macros.name: titleQuiz*
macros.doc: To assign a title to your short quiz use \titleQuiz.

macros.name: titleQuizfmt
macros.doc: The format of the title is controlled by the command \titleQuizfmt, the default definition is \newcommand\titleQuizfmt{\bfseries}.

macros.name: TUChoice
macros.doc: The tool tip for all choice fields of a quizzes can be changed with \TUChoice{<text>}, the default is \TUChoice{Choice}.

macros.name: turnOnRandomize
macros.doc: The command \turnOnRandomize overrides all local settings of \bChoices and causes all choice lists to be randomized.

macros.name: useMCCircles
macros.doc: To create circular radio buttons for a MC question execute \useMCCircles before the quiz, or, perhaps, in the preamble of your document.

macros.name: useMCCRects
macros.doc: To return to the default rectangular choice boxes, execute \useMCCRects.

macros.name: writeProListAux
macros.doc: This command saves to the auxiliary file the two pieces of information the \displaySumryTbl needs to build the table.

envs.name: exercise
envs.doc: A hypertext link is created to connect the exercise with the solution.

envs.name: manswers
envs.doc: MS questions are posed using the manswers environment, this syntax of which is the same as that of the answers environment.

envs.name: manswers
envs.doc: MS questions are posed using the manswers environment, this syntax of which is the same as that of the answers environment.

envs.name: oQuestion
envs.doc: Single questions can be posed in the oQuestion environment, multiple questions can be placed in either the shortquiz or the quiz environments.

envs.name: parts
envs.doc: The parts environment takes one optional argument, the number of columns to be used.
